lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Oh, hello there! My name is Barnaby, and I seem to have a bit of a <color=red>problem</color>.

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: I have <color=red>lost</color> three of my favourite books. I am sure I had them this morning.

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: I must have put them down while I was <color=red>wandering</color> around the camp.

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Could you <color=red>search</color> for them? They are spinning in the open, so they should be easy to spot.

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Bring them back to me and I will be very <color=red>grateful</color>!

inProgressLines.speaker: Old Barnaby
inProgressLines.text: Have you found any of my <color=red>books</color> yet? There are three of them, <color=red>scattered</color> around the camp.

inProgressLines.speaker: Old Barnaby
inProgressLines.text: Keep looking. They cannot have gone far!

completeLines.speaker: Old Barnaby
completeLines.text: You found all three! I can hardly <color=red>believe</color> it.

completeLines.speaker: Old Barnaby
completeLines.text: <color=red>Well done</color>! You have made an old man very happy today.

afterLines.speaker: Old Barnaby
afterLines.text: Thank you again for finding my books. I keep them close to me now, so they cannot <color=red>vanish</color> again!
